title: Understand corridor readiness
story: As a regional viewer, I need road status, evidence age and model uncertainty shown separately so that missing data cannot be mistaken for safe travel.
acceptance: Map has a segment table alternative
evidence: Contract tests and browser inspection of the replay corridor.

title: Capture evidence during connectivity loss
story: As a field reporter, I need to save observations on my device and synchronize without losing or duplicating reports.
acceptance: Lost acknowledgement retries reuse the report identity
Only the report owner can synchronize
evidence: 100-report controlled storage test and one browser capture/sync trial. Full field-device trial pending.

title: Review reported road conditions
story: As a reviewer, I need to accept, reject or request clarification on a scoped report with a reason before it is used as operational evidence.
acceptance: Review is persisted with actor and time
Accepting evidence alone never changes road status
evidence: Operations API tests and browser accept-review trial.

title: Publish an expiring authority decision
story: As a district officer with a recorded authority grant, I need to publish vehicle-scoped road decisions backed by reviewed evidence or an authority order.
acceptance: Role and authority grant are both required
evidence: API closure/expiry integration check and browser accepted-evidence publication trial.

title: Compare routes before medicine dispatch
story: As a dispatcher, I need legal, current route candidates with uncertainty so that I can avoid dispatching through an unsupported route.
acceptance: Vehicle restrictions checked against a dated graph
No feasible route is an explicit outcome
evidence: Mappls-backed route comparison and visible closure exclusions are implemented. Vehicle legality and approved hazard policy remain unverified.

title: Manage a medicine delivery
story: As a dispatcher, I need to create a medicine mission, assign a field reporter and record start and completion.
acceptance: Only scoped eligible reporters are assignable
evidence: Browser create/start/complete trial against disposable migrated database.

title: Share a mission location with consent
story: As an assigned field reporter, I need to share a location deliberately and see whether it was accepted without continuous hidden tracking.
acceptance: Only active assigned missions accept fixes
Out-of-corridor and impossible data are rejected or flagged
evidence: GPS API tests pass and one-time browser capture control is implemented. Real-device field trial pending.

title: Manage corridor-scoped access
story: As Super Admin, I need to create accounts and assign roles and status authority with an audit trail rather than embedding accounts or permissions in the frontend.
acceptance: Passwords are hashed and never returned
Administrator cannot remove their own admin role
evidence: Administrator scope/role/secret-exclusion tests and browser account creation against disposable migrated database.

title: Attach trustworthy report photos
story: As a field reporter, I need resumable private media uploads whose metadata is stripped and whose scan state is visible.
acceptance: Media is private until a trusted scan passes
evidence: Browser photo save/reload/upload and private scan status verified. Production malware scanner remains unconfigured; pending images cannot be viewed.

title: Recover data after an outage
story: As Super Admin, I need a verified encrypted database backup and restore procedure.
evidence: Encryption and subprocess failure tests pass. Live PostgreSQL restore demonstration pending.

title: Use evaluated predictions honestly
story: As a decision maker, I need a model card with held-out monsoon evaluation, calibration and limitations before relying on a hazard prediction.
evidence: Evaluation tooling exists. Verified real labels, held-out evaluation and partner validation are not complete.

title: Find SIH user stories and acceptance evidence
story: As Super Admin, I need a versionable register of relevant user stories and their verified status, with optional semantic search when the vector service is configured.
acceptance: Stories persist in the application database
Status is shown without claiming unverified completion
Optional vector index does not replace authoritative records
evidence: 12 stories persisted in PostgreSQL and indexed in Weaviate. Live BM25 medicine-delivery search and idempotent reindex verified; semantic embeddings are not enabled.
